tools.name: lookup_error
tools.description: Find the fix guide for an error message from an app built with Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, v0 or Supabase. Pass the exact error text (a log line, a console message, an HTTP error body). Returns the best matching guides with their links; then call get_guide with a slug for the full fix.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Read one fix guide: the causes, how to check which one applies, and the fix for each, step by step. Use a slug from lookup_error or list_guides. By default it returns the whole guide; to save tokens, set outline to true to get only its numbered sections, then pass section to read just one.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List the fix guides by group, with their slugs. Optional filter: words that must all appear in the title (e.g. "lovable deploy", "storage", "500").
